」
意識が断線する。
たった百メートルが、永遠に到達できない長さになっている。

pages.en:
“——————————”

My consciousness breaks apart.

A mere hundred meters has become a distance I can never cross, even in eternity.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“, , ”
My consciousness is breaking apart.
A mere hundred meters become an impossibly vast expanse.

pages.ja:
「
、
、
」
大空洞の崩壊は、時間の問題だった。
天蓋はところどころが崩れ、荒野のようだった地上は、瓦礫の山になりつつある。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“——————————”

It is only a matter of time before the great cavern collapses.

The canopy has given way in places. The ground, once a barren plain, is becoming a mountain of rubble.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“, , ”
It’s only a matter of time before the cavern collapses.
The ceiling’s crumbling down, and the ground is becoming a pile of rubble.

pages.ja:
「
、
、
」
関節が硬い。
手足を曲げると痛い。
神経が熱い。
体の中から、数百の刃が生えてくる。
逃げ様のない串刺し刑。
体は剣で出来ている。
それは判っていたコトだ。
投影をすれば最後、時限爆弾のスイッチが入る。
この終わりは、とうに決められていた事だ。

pages.en:
“——————————”

My joints are stiff.

It hurts to bend my limbs.

My nerves are burning.

Hundreds of blades grow from inside my body.

An inescapable sentence of impalement.

My body is made of swords.

I knew that.

The final Projection armed the time bomb.

This ending was decided long ago.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“, , ”
My joints are stiff.
It hurts to bend my limbs.
My nerves are hot.
Hundreds of blades are growing out of my body.
An inescapable death by skewering.
I am the bone of my sword.
I already knew that.
The time bomb was activated when I used projection.
This end has already been determined.

pages.ja:
「
は、あ
！」
割れる。
これ以上は割れる。
バラバラに砕けて、そこらへんに転がっている石くれと同じになる。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“——Hah… ah——!”

I'm cracking.

Any more and I will break.

I will shatter into pieces and become no different from the stones scattered around me.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Ha, ah!”
I’m crumbling apart.
I’ll shatter if I continue.
I’ll shatter to pieces, like so many rocks on the ground.

pages.ja:
……けど、まだ間に合う。
この体は手遅れだけど、ここで止めておけば一日ぐらいは意味を失わずに済む。
pages.jaRuby:
……けど、まだ間に合う。
この体は手遅れだけど、ここで止めておけば一日ぐらいは意味を失わずに済む。
pages.en:
…But there is still time.

This body is already beyond saving, but if I stop now, I could remain myself for perhaps another day.
pages.mirrorMoon:
…I’ll still make it.
My body’s dying, but I won’t lose myself for about a day if I stop now.

pages.ja:
一日だけの延命。
そんな、たいして意味のないようなコトが、今は恐ろしいほど恋しい。
たった一日。一時間でも一分でもいい。
生きていられるのなら、どんなにみっともなくても、限界までここにいたい。
pages.jaRuby:
一日だけの延命。

たった一日。一時間でも一分でもいい。

pages.en:
One more day of life.

Something so nearly meaningless is now precious beyond imagining.

Only one day. An hour would be enough. A minute.

If I can remain alive, then no matter how wretched I look, I want to stay here until the very limit.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Only a day’s worth of life prolongation.
But right now, I would love to have something so insignificant.
Just a day. An hour or even a minute.
If I can live, I want to stay here as long as I can, no matter how miserable it may be.

pages.ja:
「は、ずっ
…………！」
亀裂が入った。
外ではなく内、大脳の側座核が割れた。
行動原理、即ち快楽の連動を司るところ。
“生きる”コトに一番重要な部分。生とは快楽の追求であり、それがない人間は獣と同じ。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“Hah… ngh——…………!”

A fissure opens.

Not outside, but within: my nucleus accumbens splits apart.

The seat of motivation—the linkage of pleasure.

The part most vital to the act of “living.” Life is the pursuit of pleasure; without it, a human being is no different from a beast.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Haa, gu……!”
A crack.
Not outside, but inside. The nucleus accumbens in my cerebrum breaks.
The part that administers the principle of behavior, the linkage to pleasure.
The most important part of life. Life is the pursuit of pleasure; without it, humans would become beasts.

pages.ja:
「はっ、あ」
都合がいい、なんて事はなかった。
それでも恋しい。
自分が自分のままでいる事に、身を食むほどに執着している。
それでも割れていく。
失み欠う苦痛も、記憶の消失を止められない。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“Hah… ah.”

There is no convenient release.

Even now, I yearn for life.

My attachment to remaining myself is fierce enough to devour me.

Even so, I go on breaking.

The pain of los— ing what is miss— ing cannot halt the disappearance of memory.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Haa, ah.”
It’s not convenient.
I still want it.
I want to keep my memory for as long as I can.
But it’s disintegrating.
The pain of loss doesn’t stop the memories from fading.

pages.ja:
一歩進む度に俺は消える。
このままじゃ無理だ。
たどり着けたところで、自分が誰か、何をするかを、きっと無くしてしまっている。
だから、今は立ち止まって、助けを待

pages.en:
With every step, I disappear.

I cannot make it like this.

Even if I reach it, I will surely have lost who I am and what I came to do.

So I should stop here and wait for some— one—
pages.mirrorMoon:
I disappear the more I walk on.
I won’t make it.
Even if I do make it there, I probably won’t remember what I need to do.
So I should stop here and wait for help

でも、何か。
大きな理由が、体の外にあって。
「桜
花を見に行こう」
おまえは、おまえの役目を、果たさないと。

pages.en:
“——Ah. I remember.”

But something—

some great reason—exists outside my body.

“Sakura——let's go see the flowers.”

You have to fulfill your role.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Yeah, I remember.”
But.
Somewhere outside my body, there’s a big reason.
“Sakuralet’s go see flowers.”
So I have to fulfill my role.

pages.ja:
時間が止まっている。
痛みはない。
たった一歩に、一日をかけている。
呼吸の仕方を忘れた。
痛みはない。
たった一息の空気が、一日かけても吸えずにいる。
意味を失った。
痛みとは、なんだったか。
有機が無機に切り替わった。
踏み止まった。
落下していく中、手を伸ばして壁を掴んだ。
とても小さい。爪の先ほどの足場に、全存在を留まらせる。
保つ筈がない。
足場は、崩れて

pages.en:
——Time has stopped.

There is no pain.

A single step takes an entire day.

——I have forgotten how to breathe.

There is no pain.

Even after a day, I cannot draw one breath of air.

——Meaning has been lost.

What was pain?

The organic has become inorganic.

I halt my fall.

As I drop, I reach out and catch the wall.

The foothold is so small, no larger than the tip of a fingernail, yet I fasten the whole of my existence to it.

It cannot hold.

The foothold crumbles—
pages.mirrorMoon:
Time has stopped.
There’s no pain.
I’m taking a whole day to make just one step.
I forget how to breathe.
There’s no pain.
I couldn’t breathe if I had all day to do it.
I lose the meaning.
What was pain?
Organic matter turns into inorganic substance.
I manage to keep myself.
I reach out for the wall to keep from falling.
All the shards of my existence are gathered onto a tiny foothold.
There’s no way it’ll support me.
The foothold breaks.

pages.ja:
行動原理が喪い。
行動理由が喪い。
存在意義が喪い。
恐ろしいと感じない。
何の為に誰の為に存在しているのか消失した。

pages.en:
The principle of action is lost.

The reason for action is lost.

The meaning of existence is lost.

I feel no fear.

I have lost the purpose and the person for whom I exist.
pages.mirrorMoon:
There’s no principle of behavior.
There’s no meaning of behavior.
There’s no meaning of existence.
I don’t feel any fear.
The meaning behind my existence disappears.

pages.ja:
もう、とっくに生きていない。
如何なる理由の元にも、その腕が動く事はない。
pages.jaRuby:
もう、とっくに生きていない。
如何なる理由の元にも、その腕が動く事はない。
pages.en:
I ceased to be alive long ago.

No reason in existence can make this arm move.
pages.mirrorMoon:
I’m not alive anymore.
My arms won’t move for any reason.

pages.ja:
「
投影、」
言葉が出た。
言語野はおろか新皮質全般、他三部を含む大脳まで消失しておいて、まだ、残ったものがあった。

pages.en:
“——Trace—”

The word emerges.

Though my language center is gone, though the whole neocortex and even the rest of my cerebrum have vanished, something still remains.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Trace.”
Words come out of my mouth.
There’s something still remaining even after language, neopallium, and cerebrum are lost.

「
開始」
肉体は死んだ。
だが、ここに、魂が残されている。

pages.en:
“——on.”

The body is dead.

But here, a soul remains.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“On.”
The body dies.
But the soul remains.

pages.en:
Eight lines are woven.

The burden passes from flesh into soul, and then even meaning—

“————————Ah.”

And so Shirou Emiya died.

The form left standing is no different from a machine.

It retains the function of raising the sword it created, but without the will to move, it is only wreckage.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Spinning the eight verses.
The load transmits from the body to the soul, and more meaning is
“Ah.”
And Emiya Shirou dies.
The standing figure is no different from a machine.
It’s programmed to swing the sword, but it’s a corpse with no desire to move.

pages.ja:
だが、人工の知能がなくとも。
この世には沢山の、夢を織る機械がある。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
And yet, even without an artificial mind,

this world holds many machines that weave dreams.
pages.mirrorMoon:
But even without human intelligence…
There are machines that weave many dreams in this world.

いつか冬が過ぎて、春になったら
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
There was a promise.

Someday, when winter ended and spring came——
pages.mirrorMoon:
There was a promise.
Once winter’s over, when it’s spring

pages.ja:
もう意味さえ解らない文字の羅列。
最後まで覚えていた、果たされるべき、小さな希望。
pages.jaRuby:
もう意味さえ解らない文字の羅列。
最後まで覚えていた、果たされるべき、小さな希望。
pages.en:
A string of characters whose meaning is already lost.

The small hope he remembered until the end—the promise that had to be fulfilled.
pages.mirrorMoon:
A recitation of words without meaning.
A small hope that I remembered until the very end.
